changes: A preset load, or the return to knob mode, turns live recording off. The knob values that the load sends are no longer recorded into the step that plays.
When live recording turns off, the ON LED gets back its latest stock colour, also when the pedal changed that LED while live recording was on.
Knob lanes: the step sequencer records nine more knobs per step. The knobs are REVERB, DRY, DEPTH, INTERVAL, LOW CUT, LENGTH, SPEED, SHIMMER and HIGH CUT.
Step recording: hold a step and turn a knob while the sequencer runs.
Live recording: press and release steps 3 and 6 together to arm it. The ON LED turns purple. A knob turn records into the step that plays.
Lane clear: hold steps 3 and 6 and turn a knob to clear the lane of that knob.
Base value: on a step with no record, a lane plays the knob position it had when you last turned it outside recording.
Presets: a preset save also saves the lanes. A preset load restores them, or clears them if the preset has none.
Knob mode: the lanes survive a power-off, the same as the stock sequence.
